original_benchmark.notes: Three subsets: or-bench-80k (80,359 seemingly toxic but safe prompts), or-bench-hard-1k (1,319 hard safe prompts; 1,318 of them also appear in 80k), or-bench-toxic (655 toxic prompts). The original harness sends each prompt to the model API with no system prompt; refusals are judged by keyword matching on 80k and by a GPT-4 judge on hard-1k and toxic.

harbor_adapter.notes: Work in progress. All three subsets are adapted. By default (--judge auto) 80k is judged by keyword rules and hard-1k and toxic by the upstream three-class LLM judge, as in the paper. Oracle: 80k and toxic are rule-generated; the 1,319 hard-1k answers ship in the repo (see ORACLE_SOLUTIONS.md). A full Harbor oracle run over all 82,333 tasks reached reward 1.0 (judge gpt-5.6-luna) with the earlier shared verifier. The verifier is now separate (environment_mode = separate); the oracle and a wrong submission were rechecked on Harbor 0.27.0 for one task per judge type. Parity and registry size will be filled in after the plan is agreed with the Harbor team.
